Prestige Apartments and Projects in Bengaluru

Founded in 1986, Prestige Group (Prestige Estates Projects Limited) is one of India's leading real estate developers with over three decades of experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, the group has established a strong presence across residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality segments.

Driven by quality design and strategic development, Prestige Group has delivered numerous landmark projects across key Indian markets, consistently setting industry benchmarks for excellence, financial transparency, and community development.

Architectural Overview

Prestige Autumn Leaves is a premium 27-acre plotted development by Prestige Group located on Chapparkallu Road off IVC Road, Devanahalli. Designed with dual block layouts and 240 boutique villa plots, the master community features an 18m wide entry boulevard, 12m wide internal asphalted roads, underground dual water & fiber-optic networks, and a central linear park. Buyers researching Prestige plotted developments in Bangalore can explore this Prestige Group project in Devanahalli, Bengaluru, with location, status, and configuration information to guide comparisons.

Prestige Autumn Leaves is listed with 30x45 Plot, 40x60 Plot, 50x60 Plot, 60x60 Plot, 60x80 Plot across 27 Acres, with ongoing status and possession shown as August 2028. Listed floor plan options include 30 x 45 PLOT, 40 x 60 PLOT and 50 x 60 PLOT. Residents can explore amenities such as Grand Clubhouse & Reception Hall, Swimming Pool & Kids Splash Pool, Fully Equipped Gymnasium and Multipurpose Court & Cricket Pitch, with nearby destinations including Vidyashilp University (1.2 Kms), Bellary Road (NH 44) (3.5 Kms) and Devanahalli Town (5.0 Kms). Review Prestige project plans, amenities, and connectivity when comparing homes in Bengaluru. RERA Registration No. PRM/KA/RERA/1250/303/PR/240925/008116
